features.name: Combat Superiority
features.desc: You learn Maneuvers fueled by Superiority Dice (initially 4d8; their number and size increase). Expended and regained on a rest.

features.name: Student of War
features.desc: Proficiency with one type of Artisan's Tools of your choice and one additional skill.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.desc: By expending a Superiority Die (as a Bonus Action), you learn a creature's immunities, resistances, and vulnerabilities.

features.name: Relentless
features.desc: Once on each of your turns, you can use a maneuver without expending a Superiority Die (treat it as if you expended a d8).
